regressions_found_and_fixed_this_round: Percentage-based hero gradient: 33 AA failures across destination, city, train and journey heroes. The widened check:hero-contrast default (8 hero pages, not just the homepage) found them; re-anchoring the gradient in lengths fixed 32 and grounding the trip-type tag fixed the last.

Lotus glyph colour had never applied anywhere: ten call sites passed a colour class INTO the component, so the scoped rule compiled against the caller's cid and matched nothing. Every lotus that should have been crimson or yellow had rendered plain ink since M3. Fixed by moving colour to a `tone` prop resolved inside Lotus.astro.

Footer enquiry form overflowed the viewport by 12px at 768px and 2px at 412px: a viewport media query describing a column's width, plus an <input>'s min-content width being its `size` attribute rather than zero.
